claims.text: CareUp, a Dutch VR/AR healthcare-education platform, used the Agency Swarm framework to build a four-agent system (Social Media Manager, Content Writer, Image Generator, Facebook Manager) that automates Facebook ad creation and launch.
CareUp's multi-agent Facebook ad workflow includes a human-in-the-loop review step in Notion so ads meet quality standards before launch.
The CareUp multi-agent marketing solution achieved an 80–90% reduction in manual workload at approximately $1.02 per workflow.

Preisser Solutions' MarCommand is a custom-coded multi-agent marketing engine in which a central orchestrator coordinates a Content Strategist, Copywriter, Designer, Paid Ads Manager, AEO Architect, Analyst and Quality Reviewer agent.

In MarCommand, a Quality Reviewer agent makes a final pass on every artifact for brand voice, factual accuracy and policy compliance, and the orchestrator routes human-approval checkpoints before publishing.

MarCommand is a demonstration product used to run Preisser Solutions' own marketing operations and serves as a reference architecture for custom client builds; humans handle strategy, brand judgment and exceptions.

Keenfolks describes a parallel multi-agent system for personalizing marketing assets across 42 markets, with Research, Content, Translation, Legal, Image Generation, Quality and Routing agents; brand and legal compliance are built into the workflow.

Keenfolks reports that campaign cycles for the 42-market CPG scenario dropped from four to six weeks to hours; the Mars example (35 markets) is labelled a placeholder/optional snapshot, with the cycle cut from six weeks to under one week.

Soba Labs built a multi-agent localisation pipeline for Freedman International in which each step's output is explicit, checkable and binding on later steps, using retrieval-augmented generation over client brand rules.

In Freedman certification runs, fresh jobs passed every step with quality assurance passing and multi-market, multi-format social deliverables sealed; blocking cultural risks were flagged for the producer and each risk was tied to a source.

Klarna reported Q1 2024 sales and marketing spending down 11%, outside marketing supplier spend down 25% (about $4 million a year), image production costs down $6 million, and AI used for 80% of copywriting.
Klarna cut image production time from 6 weeks to 7 days, including checks for brand, quality and legal compliance, with over 1,000 images made with AI in three months.

Klarna's AI marketing is reported as in production, with an estimated $10 million saved in 2024; since Oct 2025 it has used Google's Veo 2 and Gemini 2.5 Flash Image for lookbooks and a library of over 200 million images.

A critical Signal article claims Klarna's AI-creative click-through rates were about 10% below the prior year's human campaign, and that AI creative underperforms human creative by 15–25% on brand-campaign recall and sentiment; these are third-party claims.
Klarna stopped expanding its customer-service bot for complex cases and began hiring human agents again.
Salesforce's own Agentforce SDR agent worked over 43,000 leads and generated $1.7 million in new pipeline from dormant leads in its first year.
Early on, Salesforce's SDR agent answered 'I don't know' 30% of the time when asked for lead details; data cleanup and iterative training reduced this to under 10%.
ZenML's review notes Salesforce's agentic-enterprise account is promotional, lacks conversion metrics for agent-led lead outreach, and does not detail guardrails or handoff rates.
SaaStr reports using Agentforce to build a sales agent that personalizes outreach to untouched leads, achieving a 72% open rate and closing $2.7 million in deals, with 20+ AI agents on one platform.
Salesforce's internal sales deployment reports an Engagement Agent that reached 100,000 leads, created 1,500 opportunities and is on track for $60 million in pipeline, plus 75% faster quote creation.
Belden runs a multi-agent Agentforce environment in production processing over 500,000 service cases annually for intake, analysis and routing, claiming 98% accuracy.

Microsoft's 'Ask Microsoft' web agent, built on Copilot Studio multi-agent orchestration with sub-agents grounded on specific parts of the site, reports up to 61% lower latency, up to 70% fewer human-handled chats, and 16% more Azure trial initiations.

Atea's 'Kate' is a multi-agent orchestrator built in Copilot Studio that routes requests to over 35 sub-agents (CRM data, contracts, tenders, customer history) via MCP servers, but is still a pilot with about 100 users.

Allianz's Project Nemo (Australia, 2025) uses seven specialized agents (planner, coverage, weather, fraud, payout, audit, cyber) for catastrophe claims, reporting an 80% cut in processing time, with human approval required at the final step for all claims.
